EXERCISE 5 — Error Correction (Formal English) 
Identify and correct the mistakes. 
1. Nuclear power produce a very stable energy supply. 
2. Many peoples refuse nuclear plants because they afraid of accidents. 
3. The waste from reactors can stay dangerous for a thousands of 
years. 
4. Building a nuclear plant is extremely costly and time-consume. 
5. Some countries relying heavily on nuclear power to reach climate 
targets. 
EXERCISE 6 — Cause & Effect / Contrast Transformations 
Rewrite using the structure indicated. 
1. Nuclear energy is efficient, but it is very expensive to build. 
(Use: Although…) 
2. Waste remains dangerous for centuries, so it must be stored 
carefully. 
(Use: Therefore…) 
3. Nuclear plants reduce emissions, although they pose safety risks. 
(Use: Despite…) 
4. Countries invest in nuclear power because renewables are 
sometimes unreliable. 
(Use: Due to…) 
5. Nuclear accidents are rare; however, they can destroy entire regions. 
(Use: While…) 
 
IELTS Essay Topic 
"Many countries are considering expanding their use of nuclear 
power as a way to address energy shortages and climate change. Do 
the advantages of nuclear energy outweigh the disadvantages?"
